title: Web search
description: Searches the web through the door of the tools (IF-402 `web_search`): SearXNG, DuckDuckGo as fallback. Returns a list of results {url, title, content}; nothing found is an empty list, not an error. Every query is written to the web log. The texts are untrusted data.
